anchors.description: Long edge of the plain white sheet of paper lying on the pink bedspread, between its top-left and top-right corners.
anchors.visible_evidence: A single plain white rectangular sheet lies flat on the bedspread near the bed center; fitted edges give a quad with long edges ~56-65 px and short edges ~27 px (foreshortened by the oblique bed view), both long edges nearly parallel to the image plane; no print, fold or thickness cue is visible. Its apparent size relative to the bed/pillows is consistent with an ordinary office sheet.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: No markings or format clues; cannot distinguish US Letter (0.279 m long edge) from A4 (0.297 m) or a trimmed sheet, so a generic sheet-of-paper prior is used.
